create_trigger.description: Create a Honeycomb trigger that checks a calculation on a schedule and alerts when it crosses a threshold, such as more than 100 server errors in 15 minutes.

trigger.description: More than 100 server errors in 15 minutes
trigger.name: Checkout errors

create_trigger.name: create_trigger

parameters.description: The dataset. Pick one (or every dataset), or give its slug from an earlier step.
parameters.name: dataset

parameters.description: Shown in Honeycomb and in each alert.
parameters.name: name

parameters.description: What to calculate. Defaults to a count of events.
parameters.name: calculation

parameters.description: The field to calculate on, such as duration_ms. Needed for every calculation except a count of events.
parameters.name: column

parameters.description: Conditions events must meet, one per line, such as status_code >= 500, service.name = checkout or error exists.
parameters.name: filters

parameters.description: Whether events must meet all the conditions or any one.
parameters.name: match

parameters.description: Whether the trigger fires above or below the threshold. Defaults to above.
parameters.name: threshold_op

parameters.description: The number the result is compared with, such as 100.
parameters.name: threshold_value

parameters.description: How often Honeycomb checks. Defaults to every 15 minutes.
parameters.name: frequency_minutes

parameters.description: How much time each check covers: from the time between checks to 4 times it. Defaults to the time between checks.
parameters.name: lookback_minutes

parameters.description: Alert once when the threshold is crossed (default), or at every check.
parameters.name: alert_on

options.label: Once, when it crosses the threshold
At every check while it is over the threshold

parameters.description: Who Honeycomb alerts: the email addresses, Slack channels and others set up under Team Settings > Integrations.
parameters.name: recipients

parameters.description: Shown on the trigger's page, such as a runbook link.
parameters.name: description

parameters.description: Turn the trigger off, so it isn't checked and sends no alerts.
parameters.name: disabled

dataset_slug.description: Its dataset, or __all__ for the whole environment

disabled.description: True if it is turned off

id.description: The trigger's ID, for the trigger steps

recipients.description: Who it notifies (each has an id, type and target)

threshold.description: When it fires: op (>, >=, <, <=) and value

triggered.description: True while it is over its threshold
